findings.message: MCQ answer-key design (docs/semester-4/efmp-408/unit-06/unit-assessment.mdx:126-135). The key is A0 / B9 / C1 / D0, so a candidate who always selects B scores 9 of 10, and no item keys to A or D. The keyed option is also the longest option in 9 of the 10 items (item 4 ties with D), a second independent giveaway. REPAIR: redistribute the keys across A-D and rebalance option length and grammatical parallelism so the correct option is not systematically the longest.
